summary: Boots into the Crash Bandicoot N. Sane Trilogy title screen (PRESS X to Begin) and holds it at ~30 FPS; could not be advanced to the main menu or gameplay during testing.
notes: Game boots, plays intro/loading, and reaches the title screen rendered at 28-30 FPS (60 samples, median 29.9, min 13.9 during load transitions). Background sky shows persistent horizontal scanline/banding corruption on the Turnip gen8 v2 driver. Pressing the on-screen X button did not advance past the title screen. In one longer run the backend exited with SIGTRAP (exitCode 133, shadPS4 'Assertion Failed! ... irq=GfxFlip token=2622 last_registered=2623') after ~144s in the GPU coroutine; in other runs it held the title screen without crashing during the capture window.
issues: GPU coroutine flip assertion causes an intermittent SIGTRAP crash (exitCode 133) during the boot/loading phase, and the title screen does not advance past PRESS X to begin.
